title: Young Man and Three Children in Country Yard, 1930s Snapshot Photo
description: A rural outdoor snapshot capturing a proud young man standing behind three young children on a dirt yard. The children are dressed in casual, period-typical attire, each wearing an oversized or distinct hat: the small boy on the left wears overalls with a striped top and a dark brimmed hat; the middle girl smiles in a light cotton dress and sun hat; and the younger girl on the right wears a ruffled white dress paired with a dark beret. Behind them is a rustic wooden clapboard outbuilding or cabin and a sparse hillside under bright sunlight, reflecting humble domestic life in rural America during the late 1930s.
